"""Image guided mahjong manipulation through the standard robot client."""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import json
OUT=Path('/app/output')
def observe():
    r=Robot()
    (OUT/'spec.json').write_text(json.dumps(r.spec(),indent=2))
    res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none')
    res.save(OUT/'initial')
    print(json.dumps(res.meta,indent=2))
if __name__=='__main__': observe()

"""Image-guided controller; all robot access is through rcb_client.
FK is a standard Panda serial-chain model, checked against measured TCP.
Commands and resulting observations are recorded in output for reproducibility.
"""
from rcb_client import Robot
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
import json,argparse
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R
from geometry import fk,ik
OUT=Path('/app/output')
def snapshot(r,name):
 res=r.get_obs(include_depth=True,video='none');res.save(OUT/name);return res
def move(r,xyz,finger=.04,seconds=3.,name='move',rot=None):
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['forward'],video='none');p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);q=p[:7]
 if rot is None:rot=np.diag([1.,-1.,-1.])
 target=ik(np.array(xyz),rot,q)
 start=p[23:32];end=np.r_[target,finger,finger]
 n=int(round(seconds/.1));a=start+(end-start)*np.linspace(0,1,n)[:,None]
 with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'xyz':xyz,'actions':a.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
 res=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=.1,cameras=['forward','left','right','wrist'],video='none',include_depth=True,note=name);res.save(OUT/name)
 print(json.dumps(res.meta));print('expected',fk(target)[:3,3]);return res
def grip(r,width,name):
 obs=r.get_obs(cameras=['forward'],video='none');p=np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now']);cmd=p[23:32];cmd[-2:]=width
 a=np.repeat(cmd[None],20,axis=0)
 with (OUT/'commands.jsonl').open('a') as f:f.write(json.dumps({'name':name,'actions':a.tolist(),'dt':.1})+'\n')
 res=r.submit('joint_position',a,dt=.1,cameras=None,video='none',include_depth=True,note=name);res.save(OUT/name);print(json.dumps(res.meta));return res
if __name__=='__main__':
 ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('op',choices=['observe','move','grip']);ap.add_argument('--xyz',type=float,nargs=3);ap.add_argument('--width',type=float,default=.04);ap.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=3);ap.add_argument('--name',default='current');a=ap.parse_args();r=Robot()
 if a.op=='observe':print(snapshot(r,a.name).meta)
 elif a.op=='move':move(r,a.xyz,a.width,a.seconds,a.name)
 else:grip(r,a.width,a.name)
PY
